== Summary ==
[[Joe Boulden]] at Decipher, 1996. Head-centred crop of [[:File:Joe Boulden with Star Wars CCG press sheets, InQuest 17 (1996).jpg]], whose caption names him. Photo: InQuest.

== Source ==
* Rick Swan, "Star Tours: How a ''Star Wars'' card is made", ''[[InQuest]]'' 17 (September 1996), pp. 54–60; photograph on p. 60. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-issue-17-images_202008/page/n61/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n61). The Internet Archive item is itself the preserved copy.
* Crop: x 55–355, y 30–390 of the 450×590 photograph, head centred.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a magazine article about how Decipher made ''Star Wars'' CCG cards, used only to identify Joe Boulden on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-9/97/Joe_Boulden_InQuest_17_%281996%29.jpg Internet Archive item].
